summary: Verified the bug fix for the duplicated close (X) button in MapExpandedModal on /colombia. Only the baked-in grey circular X in the image is now visible — the React lucide X has been removed. All three close methods (invisible hit-area over baked-in X, Esc key, backdrop click) work. Full hover→preview→SeeMore flow works end-to-end, and bilingual EN/ES strings match the spec exactly.

critical_code_review_comments: MapExpandedModal.jsx is clean: lucide X import removed, invisible hit-area button has aria-label='Close map' and keyboard focus ring — accessibility preserved.

Minor nit (not blocking): The hint

is a sibling of the aspect-ratio container but still a descendant of map-expanded-container's parent motion.div. Using data-testid for the hint text would make localized E2E assertions more robust (currently relies on class p.uppercase).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for duplicated X in /colombia MapExpandedModal verified end-to-end. Backdrop click requires clicking at coordinates outside the max-w-[600px] modal container (e.g., to the right of the container) because the top navbar sits above the backdrop (z-index) and will swallow clicks at (0,0)-ish coordinates near the viewport top-left. Framer-motion exit animations (~400ms) can cause map-expanded-container to still be queryable right after onClose fires; use wait_for_selector state='detached' for reliable assertions.
